items.name: Codename Anastasia
items.summary: Agent Kwon Taekjoo is dispatched to Russia with two tasks. First, he must find “Anastasia,” a new weapon that could change the world forever. Second, he is to avoid Russia’s psychotic killer, Psikh Bognadov, at all costs. To assist him on his undercover mission, Taekjoo is sent a partner who only reveals himself to be a man named Zhenya. But Zhenya quickly proves himself to be just as dangerous and unhinged as the infamous Psikh himself. Just who could he truly be? And will Taekjoo succeed in tracking down “Anastasia”?

items.name: Shutline
items.summary:
Shin is barely making ends meet, hustling as a rogue mechanic on the mean city streets. Problem is, work never comes easy and the dough is nothing to shout about. But when Jake pulls up with car trouble one day, it’s obvious that there’s money to be made: he’s tall, blond and dressed like a million bucks. Jackpot. And after such a handsome payday, Shin is reluctant to let this sucker go. Little does he know that giving Jake his number may be the biggest mistake he’s ever made. And it isn’t long before Jake wants more than his car fixing… *(Source: Lezhin)*

items.name: PASSION
items.summary:
Jeong Taeui has always lived in the shadow of his genius twin brother, but he’s never been unhappy with his ordinary life. When his uncle shows up at his doorstep with a dangerous job offer disguised as a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, Taeui is skeptical, but he reluctantly agrees to work as an agent for half a year. Despite his initial qualms, he quickly adjusts to his new environment using his outgoing, positive personality. But from the moment Taeui meets Ilay Riegrow, an agent from another branch, his peaceful life slowly starts to change. Everyone says Ilay is a sadistic psychopath who should be avoided at all costs, but Taeui knows there’s more to him than meets the eye. But getting to know Ilay is like playing with fire, and Taeui isn’t sure if he’s ready to get burned. *(Source: Tappytoon)*

alt_names.name: En el ojo de la tormenta

雲龍風虎〜パパたちの育児プロジェクト〜

items.summary:
Hwan Woon-ryong and Beom Pung-ho have spent their entire lives locked in a fierce rivalry. As the heirs to the world’s two most powerful crime syndicates, their hatred runs deep—and so does their competition. But just as they’re poised to seize the biggest opportunity of their careers, fate throws them a curveball: a toddler named Hwan Beom-hae, who, according to advanced DNA testing, is the biological child of both of them.

Caught between disbelief and chaos, the two enemies are presented with an absurd yet high-stakes mission: raise Beom-hae together, lovingly and responsibly. The reward? Exclusive construction rights to the largest global development project in history, sanctioned by the United Nations itself. But co-parenting isn’t exactly easy when you’d rather strangle your partner than share snack time and diaper duty.

As Beom-hae’s giggles and tantrums slowly chip away at their walls, Woon-ryong and Pung-ho must navigate tantrums, toys, and a growing sense of responsibility—not to mention some unexpected feelings. Can two lifelong enemies become the world’s most unlikely dream team dads? Or will their stubborn pride and unresolved tension bring everything crashing down?

Enemies-to-daddies has never looked this chaotic—or this heartwarming.

items.name: Desire Me if You Can
items.summary: Grayson Miller a pour but de rencontrer son âme sœur. Un chamane lui a annoncé que son partenaire serait « quelqu'un lié au feu, avec une forte poitrine ». Plus tard, il rencontre par hasard un pompier oméga remarquable au milieu d'un incendie… et s'évanouit ! Dans le but de retrouver cette personne, Grayson rejoint la caserne de pompiers, mais finit par se battre violemment avec le pompier Dane… et se retrouve inévitablement mêlé à lui malgré tout…

items.name: The S-Class Guide as Sweet as Honey
items.summary:
Jin Hyoseop is an S-class guide whose powers leave him aroused and smelling as sweet as honey. In order to hide his embarrassing secret, he joins a C-class guild on the condition that he only does the minimum guiding required to heal his esper guildmates. It shouldn’t be an issue since the guild’s kind and understanding commander Andante assures him that they don’t handle any dangerous jobs. But then, why does everyone keep coming back injured and in desperate need of guiding? Little does Hyoseop know that he has just stepped into a lair of criminal S-class espers!

A gambler. A failure. And now a divorcé after ending ten years of marriage. This is the life of Jung Cheol. With nothing going right, he barely has time to lament his misfortunes when the very person who started it all returns. Ji Minyoung, his former lover—his fear, his nightmare, and the one he loved so desperately—is back. The person who made Cheol run for most of his life stands before him again.

*“I’ll stay with you until the moment you die, Cheol.”*

items.summary:
Lee Taegun is the nation's top esper, unmatched and untouchable with how powerful he is. A veritable immovable object. But the truth is, he's not as untouchable as he seems. Like every esper out there, he experiences negative side effects of using his powers. However, unlike every esper out there, he's dead set against partnering with a guide who could help him recover. Now here comes Seo Eunsung, one of the greatest guides alive, and he's determined to guide Taegun whether he likes it or not. So: irresistible force meets immovable object. Who will fall first in this battle? Or will they both fall...for each other?

items.name: The Greatest Estate Developer

alt_names.name: 史上最高の領地設計士
Bậc Thầy Thiết Kế Điền Trang

items.summary:
While studying civil engineering, Suho Kim dozes off while immersed in a fantasy novel, only to awaken as a character from the story. 

Now inhabiting the body of Lloyd Frontera, a slothful noble with a fondness for alcohol and a family burdened by massive debts, Suho must utilize his engineering expertise to craft inventions that can prevent the grim fate awaiting him. 

With the assistance of a colossal hamster, a knight, and the magic of the world, will Suho be able to rescue his new family from their financial troubles and create a brighter future?

items.name: PEARL BOY: IGNITE THE DAWN

alt_names.name: Le garçon aux perles : Ignite the Dawn

items.summary:
Baek Seunghyun, who has spent his entire life as the right-hand man of Shin Jaeil (a yakuza boss). He had come to regard his Hyungnim as a father figure, and now that Hyungnim is getting married, Seunghyun, who runs away from the wedding, coincidentally runs into Yuta — someone he had a past relationship with in Japan 10 years ago. After all this time, trying to bury his frustration, Yuta quickly changes his expression and starts throwing out extremely unpleasant words. Who would have thought that would be the beginning of a series of annoying events? Yuta, who suddenly barges back into Seunghyun’s life… What will happen between the two of them after this unexpected reunion?

**Main Story:** [Pearl Boy](https://mangadex.org/title/232719b5-44f1-47a3-bbf7-be7aeb443ec4/pearl-boy)

items.alt_name: Tsuihou Sareta Tensei Juukishi wa Game Sashiki de Musou Suru
items.summary:
"You good-for-nothing bastard. You are the son of a Sword Saint, yet you dare pull such a defective Class?!"

During the "Divine Blessing Ceremony" of the 15-year-old Elma who came from a lineage of Sword Saints, he had manifested a commonly deemed defective class known as the Heavy Knight. He had been deprived of his position as the next head of the Edvan Household and was then exiled. The Heavy Knight class had an unbalanced status and useless skills, to top it off, it was even said to be a class cowardly and indolent people have.

But, Elma knew better—that this world was the world of the game he had used to play before—and that the Heavy Knight class was the strongest class to exist. Elma made full use of the knowledge he had in his previous life and began his efficient walkthrough of the world he was reincarnated into.

items.name: Martial Peak
items.summary: The pinnacle of martial arts is a path filled with solitude and desolation. It is a relentless quest for heights that seem impossible to reach. To exceed the boundaries of martial arts, one must possess the desire to grow and the tenacity to endure challenging circumstances. One day, Yang Kai, a disciple-on-trial (and floor sweeper) of the Lingxiao Martial Arts Sect, stumbled upon a Wordless Black Book. This event signified a change in his fortune and the commencement of his journey in martial arts.

items.name: Eleceed
items.summary:
Jiwoo is a kind-hearted young man who harnesses the lightning quick reflexes of a cat to secretly make the world a better place – one saved little child or foster pet at a time. Kayden is a secret agent on the run, who finds himself stuck in the body of a …um… decidedly fat old fluffy cat. Together, armed with Jiwoo’s super powers and Kayden’s uber-smarts, they’re out to fight those forces who would let evil rule this world. That is, if they can stand each other long enough to get the job done.

items.name: Death Is The Only Ending For The Villainess
items.summary: Penelope Eckart has been reborn as the adopted daughter of Duke Eckart and finds herself in the role of the villainess in a reverse harem dating simulation. The challenge is that she has entered the game on its most difficult setting, and no matter her actions, death is inevitable at every possible ending! Before the "real daughter" of Duke Eckart makes her appearance, Penelope must select one of the male leads and achieve a happy ending to escape her fate. However, the two brothers constantly argue with her over trivial matters, alongside a deranged crown prince, whose storylines all culminate in death. There is also a magician who is infatuated with the female lead, and a devoted slave knight! Strangely enough, the affection levels of the male leads seem to rise the more she oversteps boundaries with them! This is the tale of Penelope's struggle for survival, having been thrust into a chaotic reverse harem dating sim!

items.name: Ennead

alt_names.name: Bộ chín vĩ đại của Heliopolis

items.summary: The formerly tranquil land of Egypt has been drenched in blood due to the oppressive reign of Seth, the god of war. Horus, the son of the goddess Isis but not yet a deity himself, rises up to confront the throne and bring an end to the turmoil and devastation. What starts as a conflict fueled by animosity between Seth and Horus gradually evolves into something complicated by obsession and desire... Experience the ancient mythology of Egypt as it comes alive in a way you've never encountered before in this intriguing fantasy BL.

items.name: One Piece
items.summary:
Gol D. Roger, known as the "Pirate King," is about to be executed by the World Government. However, right before his execution, he verifies the existence of a legendary treasure, One Piece, hidden somewhere in the immense ocean known as the Grand Line. He proclaims that One Piece can be claimed by anyone who is worthy enough to find it, leading to his execution and the start of the Great Age of Pirates.  
  
Fast forward twenty-two years, a young man named Monkey D. Luffy is eager to begin his own journey, in pursuit of One Piece and aiming to become the next Pirate King. With merely a straw hat, a small boat, and a rubbery body, he starts an incredible adventure to assemble his own crew and secure a capable ship that will navigate the Grand Line, allowing them to achieve the highest honor on the seas.

items.name: High School Boy
items.summary:
Il-tak Hong is the sole girl at Daemun Boys High School. Despite his name and nickname, he is indeed a man, but due to his small size and unusual looks, he is scorned by everyone. In the past, Il-tak was a notorious bully until the second year of middle school; however, he fell to the bottom of the social hierarchy because of one issue... puberty hit everyone but him. 

Il-tak devised a plan to improve his status... "If I become friends with Hyun-woo Lee, the true dominant figure in the second grade of the school, I can regain my position among the bullies!" 

Yet, for some unknown reason, Hyun-woo is attempting to keep his distance from Il-tak... Will he manage to restore his former prestige?

items.name: Blue Lock

alt_names.name: BLUE LOCK ขังดวลแข้ง
Blue Lock - As It Should Be
Blue Lock - Right of Final Interpretation

items.summary:
Yoichi Isagi lost the opportunity to go to the national high school championships because he passed to his teammate who missed instead of shooting himself. Isagi is one of 300 U-18 strikers chosen by Jinpachi Ego, a man who was hired by the Japan Football Association after the 2018 FIFA World Cup, to guide Japan to winning the World Cup by destroying Japanese football. Ego's plan is to isolate the 300 strikers into a prison-like institution called "Blue Lock", in order to create the world's biggest "egotist"/striker, which has been lacking in Japanese football.
___
